title: REQ · ContributionSheet is a Radix dialog with focus trap, Escape and a title and description
summary: Sheet uses Dialog parts so Radix supplies focus trap, Escape and ARIA labelling
description: Context: ContributionSheet.tsx returns a plain div with role=dialog and a Close button. Desired behavior: render it inside Dialog with open and onOpenChange mapped to onClose, DialogTitle Suggest What Happens Next and DialogDescription Ideas are considered when the Round closes. Expected result: Escape closes, Tab is trapped, name and description are announced. Why: accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet is open, when Escape is pressed, then onClose is called once
Given the sheet is open, then getByRole dialog has accessible name Suggest What Happens Next and a non-empty accessible description
Given open is false, then no dialog is rendered
Given the Close button is clicked, then onClose is called
Given existing submit and history flows, then they behave as before

preserve: Send button and Your idea label

technical_constraints: Keep hooks before any early return
